event_log.name: The Jade Idol
event_log.narrative: The temple wants the Jade Idol off the barrow king's altar and back on its own.

event_log.name: Recover the idol
event_log.narrative: The idol comes up out of the hollow, cold as well-water.

event_log.name: Bring it home
event_log.narrative: Threshold's gate shuts behind you with the idol inside it.

event_log.name: The Jade Idol
event_log.narrative: The almoner counts out the reward without looking up. The idol is home.

The almoner counts out the reward without looking up. The idol is home.
